subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: For Feishu gateway-restart delivery recovery, should OpenClaw add a channel-owned reconnect/readiness drain, gate generic startup recovery on channel readiness, reset retry counts across restarts, or wait for live proof before choosing?
rationale: The code clearly lacks a Feishu reconnect drain, but the issue's proposed fixed sleep and retry reset are broad policy choices that could affect retry semantics and genuine delivery failures.

options.title: Live-prove then add Feishu reconnect drain
options.body: Confirm the Feishu restart failure with queued deliveries, then use the existing drainPendingDeliveries seam from Feishu onReady/onReconnected with focused tests.

options.title: Gate generic startup recovery
options.body: Make outbound startup recovery wait for channel readiness where possible, accepting a broader core lifecycle change across channels.

options.title: Reset restart retry budget
options.body: Treat gateway restart as a retry-budget boundary, accepting the risk that repeated genuine failures may be hidden unless the policy is tightly scoped.

recommendation.title: Live-prove then add Feishu reconnect drain
recommendation.body: Confirm the Feishu restart failure with queued deliveries, then use the existing drainPendingDeliveries seam from Feishu onReady/onReconnected with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans core recovery semantics, gateway startup timing, and Feishu transport boundaries that recent history routes through steipete-owned changes.
